text:
ARCH Market Wave is a long-only spot crypto strategy designed for major exchange pairs on liquid USD/USDT/EUR charts. It scales into long exposure on confirmed bars when price falls sharply versus the prior close, and scales out when price rises sharply versus the prior close. Orders are evaluated on bar close unless the user explicitly enables tick-level fills for live experimentation.

A dual moving-average envelope built from recent lows (entry reference) and recent highs (exit reference) can gate buys below the entry reference and sells above the exit reference, with optional percentage buffers so signals do not hug the envelope.

Optional regime filters include a volatility-band trend state (breakout up / breakdown down) that can defer entries until a trend change, and static price ceilings/floors that block buys above or sells below user-defined levels.

Trade sizing supports fixed notional clips or a percentage of effective cash/position, subject to a minimum order notional suitable for retail spot accounts.

The strategy is intended for iterative tuning on the user's chart: interpret visible bar momentum, envelope distance, and open position size — never infer or state hidden factory settings.
